audit_rows.test_name: Yüzey Hazırlığı, Kumlama ve Temizlik (Surface Preparation & Blasting)
audit_rows.standard_frequency: Her boru (%100 Sa 2.5 görsel) | Pürüzlülük/Toz/Tuz: 4 saatte 1
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Surface roughness profile: Rz 60 µm - 100 µm with sharp angular profile for optimal FBE mechanical interlock
audit_rows.standard_criteria: Temizlik: Min Sa 2½ (ISO 8501-1); Pürüzlülük: Rz 60-100 µm; Çiğ noktası +3 °C üzerinde; Toz Sınıfı ≤ 2; Tuz ≤ 20 mg/m² (2 µg/cm²)
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🔴 FREKANS YETERSİZ: Standart gereği bu test İSTİSNASIZ HER BORUDA (%100) yapılmalıdır; 'Twice per 8-hour shift (3 pipes each)' kabul edilemez.

audit_rows.test_name: 3LPE / HDPE Kaplama Kalınlığı (Coating Thickness - FBE/Adhesive/PE)
audit_rows.uploaded_frequency: 100% of all pipes (4 points per length)
audit_rows.standard_frequency: Her boruda (%100 boru boyunca en az 12 nokta + kaynak kepi üzeri 4 nokta)
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Minimum total thickness: >= 3.0 mm on body, >= 2.5 mm on weld seam. No under-thickness permitted
audit_rows.standard_criteria: FBE Astar ≥ 120 µm; Yapıştırıcı ≥ 120 µm; Toplam 3LPE/HDPE ≥ 3.0 mm (3000 µm) (Kaynak kepi üzeri min kalınlıktan max %10 düşük olabilir)
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟢 API Spec 5L 47. Baskı ve hesaplanan boru parametrelerine tam uyumludur.

audit_rows.test_name: Elektrik Porozite / Süreksizlik Testi (Holiday Detection 25 kV)
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: High-voltage spark testing: 25 kV (or 5 kV/mm). ZERO holidays / pinholes permitted per pipe length
audit_rows.standard_criteria: Test Gerilimi: 25.000 Volt (25 kV); Sıfır Kıvılcım / Hatasız (%100 kusursuz yalıtım)
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🔴 HOLIDAY TEST GERİLİMİ HATALI: BOTAŞ 5410 R1 uyarınca test gerilimi 25.000 Volt (25 kV) olmalı ve kesinlikle kıvılcım/delik oluşmamalıdır!

audit_rows.test_name: Soyulma Mukavemeti / Yapışma Testi (Peel Adhesion Test)
audit_rows.standard_frequency: İlk boru ve her PE partisinde / her vardiya (3 adet numune)
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: At 23 °C: Minimum 35 N/cm; At 50 °C: Minimum 15 N/cm. Failure mode: Cohesive within adhesive/PE (no steel disbond)
audit_rows.standard_criteria: (23 ± 2) °C'de ≥ 150 N/cm (veya ≥ 18 N/mm); (50 ± 2) °C'de ≥ 15 N/cm; Test hızı: 10 mm/dakika
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🔴 SOYULMA MUKAVEMETİ YETERSİZ: BOTAŞ 5410 R1 uyarınca 23 °C'de yapışma direnci en az 150 N/cm (veya 15 N/mm) olmalıdır!

audit_rows.test_name: Kaplama Darbe Direnci Testi (Impact Resistance Test)
audit_rows.standard_frequency: Her vardiya ve et kalınlığı değişiminde (20 darbe)
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Impact resistance: >= 7.0 J/mm (zero holiday at 25 kV after impact); Indentation depth: <= 0.2 mm at 23 °C
audit_rows.standard_criteria: Darbe Direnci ≥ 5 J/mm (23 ± 2 °C); 2.5 kg ağırlık 1 m'den düşürülecek; darbe sonrası 25 kV holiday testinde delinme/kıvılcım olmayacak
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟢 API Spec 5L 47. Baskı ve hesaplanan boru parametrelerine tam uyumludur.

audit_rows.test_name: Delici Uca Batma / Girinti Direnci (Indentation Test)
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Impact resistance: >= 7.0 J/mm (zero holiday at 25 kV after impact); Indentation depth: <= 0.2 mm at 23 °C
audit_rows.standard_criteria: Batma Derinliği: (23 ± 2) °C'de Azami 0.20 mm; (50 ± 2) °C'de Azami 0.30 mm
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟢 API Spec 5L 47. Baskı ve hesaplanan boru parametrelerine tam uyumludur.

audit_rows.test_name: Katodik Soyulma Testi (Cathodic Disbondment - CD Test)
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: 28 days at 23 °C: Disbondment radius <= 7.0 mm; 48 hours at 65 °C: Disbondment radius <= 7.0 mm
audit_rows.standard_criteria: 20 °C (28 Gün - 1.5 V): Max 7.0 mm soyulma yarıçapı | 65 °C (24 Saat - 3.5 V): Max 7.0 mm soyulma yarıçapı
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟢 API Spec 5L 47. Baskı ve hesaplanan boru parametrelerine tam uyumludur.

audit_rows.test_name: Kaplamasız Uç Bölgesi ve Pah Açısı (Cutback Distance & Bevel)
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Cutback length: 150 mm +- 20 mm; Chamfer angle: <= 30°; bare steel free of coating residue, bevel protector installed
audit_rows.standard_criteria: Cutback mesafesi: 80 - 100 mm; Kaplamasız boyasız bölüm: 45 - 55 mm; PE Pah Açısı: 20° - 30° (veya 30° - 50°); Korozyona karşı geçici şeffaf vernik koruması ve koruyucu uç tapası
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟢 API Spec 5L 47. Baskı ve hesaplanan boru parametrelerine tam uyumludur.

audit_rows.test_name: Kaplama Kusur Tamir Kuralları (Coating Repair Limitations)
audit_rows.standard_frequency: Uygulanan her kaplama tamirinde istisnasız uygulanır
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Max defect size <= 100 cm2, max 2 repairs per pipe. Melt stick + PE patch; 100% holiday re-tested at 25 kV
audit_rows.standard_criteria: Bir boruda azami 3 tamir; Tek tamir alanı max 25 cm²; Toplam tamir alanı max 200 cm²; Astar boyaya inen hasarlarda ısıyla büzüşen yama ile min 50 mm sağlam kaplama üzerine bindirme; Tamir sonrası %100 25 kV holiday kontrolü
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟢 API Spec 5L 47. Baskı ve hesaplanan boru parametrelerine tam uyumludur.

audit_rows.test_name: Raw Material Verification (HDPE, Adhesive, FBE) - Every batch/delivery lot of coating materials
audit_rows.uploaded_frequency: Every batch/delivery lot of coating materials
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: FBE: Gel time, moisture <= 0.5%, DSC Tg; Adhesive: MFR, density; PE: Density >= 0.940 g/cm3, MFR 0.2-0.7 g/10min, carbon black 2.0-2.5%, EN 10204 3.1 certs
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Bare Pipe Receipt & Pre-Washing - 100% bare pipe joints before entry
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: No oil, grease, salt, lacquers, slivers or surface gouges; high-pressure potable water wash to remove contaminants
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Pipe Pre-Heating Prior to Blasting - Continuous monitoring all pipes
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Steel temperature 40 °C - 60 °C and minimum 3 °C above ambient dew point to ensure completely dry surface
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Abrasive Blast Cleaning - 100% of all pipes (continuous run)
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Cleanliness: Sa 2.5 (Near-White Metal). Steel grit/shot mix; free of mill scale, rust, and surface defects
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Residual Dust Level Inspection - At start of shift and every 2 hours
audit_rows.uploaded_frequency: At start of shift and every 2 hours
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Dust rating: Maximum Class 1 or Class 2; blown clean with dry oil-free compressed air
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Water-Soluble Salt Contamination Test - 3 tests per shift (at pipe ends & middle)
audit_rows.uploaded_frequency: 3 tests per shift (at pipe ends & middle)
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Residual chloride/salt level: <= 20 mg/m² (2.0 µg/cm²). If exceeded, re-wash with DI water and re-blast
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Chemical Surface Pre-Treatment - Continuous monitoring of bath & pipe
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Phosphoric acid or chromate pre-treatment followed by DI water rinse; surface conductivity < 50 µS/cm
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Induction Heating for FBE Coating - Continuous pyrometer & infrared logger
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Steel temperature 190 °C - 220 °C (maximum allowable 230 °C). Overheating > 240 °C causes rejection
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Fusion Bonded Epoxy (FBE) Application - Continuous electrostatic powder spray
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Dry film thickness (DFT): 150 µm - 250 µm (target 200 µm). Uniform cloud, partial cure verification
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Grafted Copolymer Adhesive Extrusion - Continuous side-wrap extrusion
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Adhesive thickness: 150 µm - 250 µm (target 200 µm). Full fusion with FBE before epoxy full cure
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Polyethylene (HDPE) Topcoat Application - Continuous circumferential wrapping
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Total 3LPE thickness: Minimum 3.0 mm (Reinforced Class v / Class C); weld seam min 85% of nominal body
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Water Quench Cooling & Temperature - 100% coated pipes through quench trough
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Controlled water cooling; pipe surface temperature reduced to < 60 °C before conveyor handling and stenciling
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Elongation at Break (PE Layer) - 1 test per raw material lot
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: Tensile elongation at break: Minimum >= 400% at 23 °C (demonstrating cold-bending ductile flexibility)
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.

audit_rows.test_name: Final Visual, Stenciling & Release - 100% of all finished coated pipes
audit_rows.uploaded_criteria: 100% visual inspection; UV-resistant white paint stencil; heavy-duty end caps fitted; EN 10204 3.1 3LPE cert
audit_rows.audit_remarks: 🟡 Standart haricinde ek kalite kontrol testi taahhüt edilmiştir.
